title: Caged Retractions of Polymatroids
summary: We develop a unified theory of caged retractions of discrete polymatroids. Given a polymatroid and a cage $κ$, the $κ$-retraction is a canonical $κ$-caged polymatroid obtained by projecting bases into the cage and retaining the maximal projected bases. We prove that this construction agrees with an explicit rank-function formula. We show that the inclusion of the $κ$-caged polymatroids into all polymatroids and the $κ$-retraction form a Galois connection with respect to the weak-map order.
